services.name: All exhibitions
services.desc: An object can carry associations to a time, a place, an event, even an idea. When we see those objects, those associations are brought to mind - we remember that time or place, event or idea. Explore decades of KWAG history as we shine a light on the significant stories and relationships that have made the Gallery what it is today. Land Bodies, Decomposing Mass is an audio-visual collaboration exploring the embodiment and translation of peatland knowledge through blending physical engagement with digital interpretations. Highlighting works by students from across the Waterloo Region, Cambridge, and selected works from the KWAG Permanent Collection. Organized by the Public Programs

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: We are thrilled to bring you another year of exciting art camps! Campers aged 6-13, will dive into a fun new theme each week, designed to spark imagination and creativity while exploring our captivating exhibitions. With expert art instructors and friendly camp counselors guiding the way, your child will build artistic skills, forge new friendships, and boost their confidence in a vibrant, welcoming environment. Plus, they’ll enjoy outdoor playtime at the beautiful Civic Centre Park and in our Garden of Resilience. Schedule:Drop-off is from 8:30 a.m. to 9:00 a.m.Camp runs from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.Pick up is from 4:00 p.m. to 4:15 p.m.Extended aftercare is available for $50/week or $15/day

services.name: Space Rentals
services.desc: The Gallery’s Community Access Space (CAS) offers an inspiring location for your special event, with a delightful view of the adjacent park and historic neighbourhood. This elegant setting is well suited for seminars, lectures, film screenings, wine tastings, business networking events, staff/client appreciation, receptions, retirement parties, staff parties, training sessions and workshops. Add further inspiration to your event by including an informal visit to our current exhibitions in your itinerary or ask about our tours and specialized visual arts and creativity programming. Room rentals include admission to the exhibition
